intro: Quiet, romantic destinations for honeymoons and couples — lovely beaches, clear water and private resorts, each with where to stay.

blocks.html: Short answer: For quiet, clear-water islands choose Koh Kood or Koh Mak (Trat); for quiet luxury, Khao Lak (Khuk Khak); for dramatic cliff scenery, Railay/Phra Nang; for a clear-water southern island, Koh Lipe; on Samui, a quiet cove like Chaweng Noi.

items.name: Koh Kood (Trat)
items.blurb: Calm clear water, green jungle, quiet beaches and sunset-view resorts with no nightlife — a true two-person retreat.

items.name: Koh Mak (Trat)
items.blurb: A small, quiet island to cycle together, with calm clear water, lovely sunsets and friendly resort owners.

items.name: Khao Lak (Phang Nga)
items.blurb: The Khuk Khak/Bang Sak stretch to the north is quiet with upscale resorts, private long beaches and the Similans nearby — great for laid-back couples.

items.name: Railay / Phra Nang (Krabi)
items.blurb: Dramatic limestone cliffs reached only by boat, with the stunning Phra Nang beach — romantic and private.

items.name: Koh Samui (Chaweng Noi/Bophut)
items.blurb: Pick a quiet cove like Chaweng Noi or Bophut — luxury resorts, beachfront dinners and direct flights to the island, convenient for couples.

items.name: Koh Lipe (Satun)
items.blurb: The clearest water in the lower Andaman, white sand and fine sunsets, with beachfront resorts — ideal for sea-loving couples.

faq.q: Which island is quietest for a honeymoon?
faq.a: Koh Kood and Koh Mak (Trat) are the quietest and most private, with no nightlife and calm clear water — ideal for two. For the clearest water, Koh Lipe is a touch livelier but stunning.

faq.q: What is the best season for a Thailand honeymoon?
faq.a: The Andaman (Khao Lak, Railay, Lipe) is best Nov–Apr, while the east (Koh Kood, Koh Mak) and the Gulf (Samui) avoid their own monsoon months; overall, Jan–Mar is good almost everywhere.
Koh Mak and Koh Kood have resorts at a range of prices, including affordable beachfront bungalows, and Koh Lipe drops a lot outside high season — book ahead and avoid long weekends for better rates.
